correctness.rationale: Each vertex is a unique increasing path. Its arc-incidence vector has Boolean coordinates, giving squared Euclidean distance equal to symmetric-difference cardinality. The final-source 11 / last-nonzero 11 automaton yields the displayed \(2\times 2\) exact generating function. Summing pairwise shared-edge probabilities gives mean \(5m/6+(8/9)(1-4^{-m})\). The dominant eigenvalue at z=1 is 1 with subleading eigenvalue 1/4 and log lambda(e^t)=5t/6+\(43t^2/216\)+O(t^3), proving the CLT and variance. Exact-arithmetic direct pair enumeration reproduces every distance coefficient for m=0..7; checks are not confused with an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A full exact metric-distance generating law for the exponentially large vertex set of a canonical flow polytope is mathematically more informative than a routine vertex count: it determines all Euclidean pairwise-distance moments and yields the sharp unscaled limiting normal law with variance \(43/360\) even though the ambient edge dimension is quadratic. The chosen quantity measures a natural global geometry of uniformly sampled vertices and is not implied by existing face/vector and volume enumerations.
